title: One pet. A shared routine.
sentences: Meet Mochi. Emma and Alex share the care.
Paw Twin brings their daily routine into one shared place.

title: Start with recorded facts
sentences: Two sample weights, seven days apart, show a hundred fifty gram increase.
The report keeps the calculation tied to its records, and missing food intake stays unknown.

title: Remember only what the owner confirms
sentences: Mochi likes a feather toy and rests after meals.
Emma confirms that preference before it becomes part of their shared pet context.

title: A new conversation. The same context.
sentences: Alex starts a fresh conversation in the Alexa web simulator.
The next answer reads the same confirmed preference and makes its source available to inspect.

title: Ask for a plan
sentences: Emma asks for playtime and chooses a time.
The draft lets her review the plan before any care task exists.

title: Review the arrangement
sentences: The prepared proposal is ready for review.
It still needs an explicit confirmation.

title: Confirm. Then hand it over.
sentences: Emma confirms one shared manual care task.
The result is clear: planned, and waiting for a person to complete it.

title: Alex takes over
sentences: Alex claims the task and records the playtime as completed.
His account is attached to the record, so the handoff stays traceable.

title: Know who recorded the result
sentences: The household history identifies Alex and the completed care.
Everyone can check the recorded result.

title: Close the loop
sentences: Emma's daily report now counts one completed manual care task.
It summarizes the saved records without inventing a health outcome.

title: Limited access for a helper
sentences: A helper can receive temporary, read-only access to one selected pet.
The owner can revoke it.

title: Bring the records to a visit
sentences: The visit card organizes dated records and shows what is missing.
It can be printed or saved for review with a veterinarian.

title: Keep the owner in control
sentences: When Emma deletes a preference, the next answer stops using it.
A remembered fact is always subject to the owner's control.

title: A routine the family can follow
sentences: Paw Twin connects the pet's records, shared plans, and recorded care.
This prototype uses local rules and SQLite. Alexa is a web simulation; live cloud and hardware integrations remain unverified.
